I sat down with a solo founder who's built a mobile app business making over $1M/year using no-code apps. He breaks down how influencer marketing and ugc marketing played a massive role in his app marketing success. You'll learn the exact app growth strategy he used, how creator partnerships helped scale, and why equity partnerships with influencers are the future of the creator economy.

We also get into bootstrap startup tactics, what it's like being an indie app developer, and how he developed a smart app distribution strategy to push his consumer apps without relying on traditional ads. If you're building apps or exploring the app studio model, this episode is packed with insights.

He shares how to build apps with influencers, how tiktok app marketing, instagram reels growth, and youtube shorts strategy boosted visibility, and dives into app monetization techniques that actually work.
